title: A Relic Unburned
summary: Sister Oriel Vane was told to burn the ember-lamp of Saint Idony. She hid it in a milestone. Return it to the Dawn Throne or hide it among the Ashford stones.
offer_text: I left the lamp in a milestone on the King's Ember Road. I should go back for it. I should not go alone.

objectives.text: Walk the King's Ember Road to Oriel's milestone
Hear what Envoy Lucan asks of the lamp

options.text: Carry the lamp to the Dawn Throne
options.say: Oriel closes her hand on the brass. "Then he will know I kept my vow. Even if I broke the other."

options.text: Set the lamp in an Ashford stone
options.say: Oriel breathes out. "Then it will not be alone. Stones keep company well."

objectives.text: Carry Saint Idony's lamp to the envoy's chapel-house in Kingsreach

relationship.label: You gave the lamp back to the sun

objectives.text: Set Saint Idony's lamp into the Ashford ring

relationship.label: You gave the lamp a stone to rest in
